A major component of the International Tourism Mart was the structured business-to-business (B2B) meetings, which provided a platform for direct engagement between domestic and international buyers and tourism sellers.

Earlier, during the technical sessions, Shri Suman Billa, Additional Secretary and Director General, Ministry of Tourism, delivered the keynote address highlighting India ’ s significant growth in domestic tourism, with Domestic Tourist Visits increasing from 1.32 billion in 2014 to 4.34 billion …
He noted that the tourism sector supports 89 million jobs and contributes 5.22% to the national GDP.
